title: Rational $S$-functions for second order ODEs with non-Liouvillian first integrals
authors: L. A. C. P. da Mota
summary: The $S$-function method for rational second order ODEs $y''=\varphi(x,y,y')$ uses $S=I_y/I_z$, attached to a first integral $I$, which satisfies a Riccati equation along the flow; it was designed for Liouvillian $I$. We study the case of rational $S$ with non-Liouvillian $I$. From any rational $g(x,y,z)$ with $g_z\neq0$ and any linear equation $A_2w''+A_1w'+A_0w=0$ with polynomial coefficients, the substitution $w'/w=g(x,y,y')$ yields a rational 2ODE whose first integral is built from two independent solutions, and $S=g_y/g_z$: the Wronskian cancels, so $S$ does not see the linear equation,…
